blocks.text: Japanese girl group kiOra have released the music video for their second single, “KIRAKIRA,” on their official YouTube channel. The video premiered on November 14, a day after the song’s digital release. This follows the four-member group’s first showcase in Japan, held earlier that day in Osaka. The event marked their first performance of “KIRAKIRA” in Japan, following its premiere at YouTube Music Nights 2026 in Jakarta, Indonesia, on November 5.
